articles.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. (NYSE: DKS) will announce results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 before the market opens on Wednesday, May 27 th . The call is being webcast and can be accessed at DICK'S Sporting Goods' Investor Relations website at investors.dicks.com .
